note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 Package 2 affiliation evidence corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, evidence, acceptance, or release.

findings.title: Evidence-gap finding template
findings.retest_or_reexercise_requirement: Closure requires the applicable retest or re-exercise evidence.
findings.release_effect: Blocks release until remediated or waived with expiry.

findings.title: Defect finding template
findings.retest_or_reexercise_requirement: Closure requires the applicable retest evidence.
findings.release_effect: Blocks release until remediated or waived with expiry.

conditions.title: Conditional-acceptance template
conditions.expiry: Expiry date recorded; an expired condition is a fail-closed gate condition.
conditions.revalidation_condition: Revalidated when the underlying evidence changes.
conditions.release_effect: Conditional acceptance is not unconditional acceptance.

conditions.title: Deferred-obligation template
conditions.revalidation_condition: Revalidated at expiry or on environment change.
conditions.release_effect: A deferred obligation does not discharge the requirement.

waivers.title: Waiver template
waivers.expiry: Expiry date recorded; an expired waiver is a fail-closed gate condition.
waivers.compensating_control_dependency: Depends on a defined and operating compensating control.
waivers.release_effect: A waiver approved is not a failure converted to success.

material_commitments.title: Material-commitment template
material_commitments.required_evidence: The evidence that would evidence fulfilment.
material_commitments.release_effect: A commitment recorded is not a commitment fulfilled.

decision_boundaries.title: Club affiliation is the first evidence-definition vertical
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: An affiliation evidence definition is never another vertical's evidence.

decision_boundaries.title: Dossier completeness is not evidence availability is not acceptance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Dossier section defined is never dossier populated is never acceptance granted.

decision_boundaries.title: Implementation completion is not accepted evidence
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Implementation completed is never implementation evidence accepted.

decision_boundaries.title: Schema inspection is not database behaviour
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Schema exists is never database invariant proven.

decision_boundaries.title: Authentication is not authorization
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Authentication evidence is never authorization evidence.

decision_boundaries.title: A mocked or single-provider result is not end-to-end evidence
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Mocked provider result is never provider integration evidence is never operational proof.

decision_boundaries.title: Migration execution is not migration acceptance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Migration executed is never migration accepted is never source retired.

decision_boundaries.title: Accessibility automation is not accessibility acceptance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Automated accessibility scan is never conformance determination.

decision_boundaries.title: Bilingual string checks are not semantic acceptance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: English and French strings exist is never semantic equivalence.

decision_boundaries.title: Operational exercise is not operational acceptance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Operational exercise conducted is never operational acceptance granted.

decision_boundaries.title: Provider certification is not institutional assurance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Provider certification is never end-to-end operational assurance.

decision_boundaries.title: Technical acceptance is not business or executive acceptance
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Technical acceptance is never business acceptance or executive authorization.

decision_boundaries.title: Executive authorization cannot substitute for missing evidence
decision_boundaries.prohibited_inference: Executive support is never evidence substitution.
